crossRefs.note: So he caused Yahweh’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.

translations.web: So he caused Yahweh’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.
translations.bsb: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. And the people returned to the camp and spent the night there.
translations.kjv: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
translations.asv: So he caused the ark of Jehovah to compass the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
